name: After § 8
title: REPORT on human rights and democracy in the world and the European Union’s policy on the matter – annual report 2025
part_text: 2b. Is deeply concerned by the significant increase in the funding and influence of organisations and anti-democratic movements seeking to erode progress on women’s rights and gender equality across Europe between 2019 and 2023, amounting to USD 1.18 billion and involving some 275 organisations; notes that one in four governments worldwide has reported a backlash against women’s rights, therefore showing that women’s rights are globally under attack;
